blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
A warehouse is more than a big room full of boxes. It is an organised space. Every product has its own location. The goal is simple: move goods in, store them safely, find them fast, and send them out again.

A good layout helps a lot. Fast-moving items go near the door. Heavy items go on the ground. Small items go in labelled bins. Nothing is random.

The layout saves steps and saves time. Every second saved in a warehouse pays off a hundred times over.

items.q: What is a warehouse, according to the text?
options: A small office near the door
A big room full of random boxes
A place only for heavy items
An organised space where every product has a location
items.why: "It is an organised space. Every product has its own location."

items.q: Where do fast-moving items go?
items.why: "Fast-moving items go near the door."

items.q: Why do heavy items go on the ground?
options: The text does not say the exact reason, but it is safer and easier
The text says it keeps workers safe
items.why: Inferência: pesado no chão evita acidentes e é mais fácil de mover — o texto não explica, mas é a razão lógica.

items.q: The author would most likely DISAGREE with which idea?
options: Small items go in labelled bins
You can store items in any random place
items.why: Inferência: o texto diz "Nothing is random" — o autor discorda de guardar em qualquer lugar.

items.q: "Every second saved pays off a hundred times over" suggests that…
options: small time savings become very big savings
items.why: Inferência: um pequeno ganho de tempo, repetido muitas vezes, vira um ganho grande.

blocks.instruction: Ouça Emily mostrando o armazém para um novo funcionário. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Welcome to the warehouse! This is your first tour, so stay close to me. Let me show you how everything works here.

Look at the door. The boxes near the door are our fast-moving items. We send these out every day, so we keep them close. Short steps, less time.

Now look down at the ground. The heavy boxes are always on the floor, never up high. It is safer for you, and it is easier to move them.

Over here, on the shelves, we have the small parts. Every bin has a label. If you need a part, read the label and go straight to it. Do not guess. Do not walk around the room. The label tells you where it is.

One more thing. Nothing here is random. Every item has a location, and every location has a reason. When you put a box back, put it in the right place. If you save one step, you save time. And time is money in a warehouse.

Okay? Any questions? Good. Let's start.
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: Why are the boxes near the door?
options: They are fast-moving items sent out every day
items.why: "The boxes near the door are our fast-moving items. We send these out every day."

items.q: Where are the heavy boxes?
items.why: "The heavy boxes are always on the floor, never up high."

items.q: What should the trainee do to find a small part?
options: Read the label on the bin
items.why: "Every bin has a label… read the label and go straight to it."

items.q: Why does Emily say "Do not guess. Do not walk around the room"?
items.why: Inferência: ela quer que o funcionário economize passos e tempo, indo direto ao lugar certo.

items.q: What does Emily think is the most important idea?
options: Good organisation saves time and money
items.why: Inferência: ela repete que nada é aleatório e que economizar um passo economiza tempo e dinheiro.

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "We keep all the boxes in the warehouse." A warehouse is…
options: a big building where goods are stored
items.why: Warehouse = armazém: prédio onde as mercadorias ficam guardadas.

items.q: "The new layout is much better." Layout means…
items.why: Layout = disposição: como o espaço é organizado.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "Please ___ these boxes on the top shelf."
items.why: To store = armazenar, guardar.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "This part is easy to find because it is in a ___."
items.why: Labelled bin = caixa etiquetada, que ajuda a achar rápido.

items.q: "The good layout will pay off in the end." To pay off means…
options: to be worth it, to bring a good result
to cost a lot of money
items.why: To pay off = valer a pena, trazer bom resultado.

blocks.instruction: Expressões que aparecem no trabalho de armazém e logística. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "The manager has to sign off on the new layout." To sign off on means to…
items.why: Sign off on = aprovar formalmente, dar o aval.

items.q: "We will roll out the new system next week." To roll out means to…
options: start using it, put it in place
items.why: Roll out = implementar, colocar em uso.

items.q: "Please keep track of the boxes near the door." To keep track of means to…
options: watch and know where they are
items.why: Keep track of = acompanhar, saber onde as coisas estão.

items.q: "We need to speed up the deliveries." To speed up means to…
items.why: Speed up = acelerar, fazer mais rápido.

items.q: "The team ran out of space on the shelves." To run out of means to…
items.why: Run out of = ficar sem, esgotar.
